methodSections.heading: Sprouts' Famous Vegan Brownies
steps: Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl and mix the wet ingredients together in another bowl.

Create a mound out of the dry ingredients in the bowl and dig a little well in the top. Add the wet ingredients gradually into the well and stir together with a spatula. Allow to rest for around 30 minutes or even overnight.
Spread onto a baking tray lined with parchment paper about 2-3cm (1in) deep or 3-4cm (1½in) for extra fudgy brownies.
